messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a catalog enable for rdo-4b-q2 tomorrow in the 06:00-07:30 UTC change window. Goal: add a low-cost fallback for chat and assistant routes. Please check fallback ordering, cache TTL, and rollback conditions.

deploy-bot: Scheduling: catalog.enable rdo-4b-q2 canary at 2026-03-23T06:15:00Z. Canary progression: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Watchers: @mike @sara. Job ID: jobs/4988.

sara: Note: our default fallback ladder currently puts quant after fp16 variants. For cost-first routes we should promote the quant variant to be preferred. Also exclude embeddings and rerank routes.

maria: Agreed. Proposed ladder: rdo-4b-q2 (quant) -> rdo-4b-8bit -> rdo-8b-fp16. I've pushed the pinlist change to infra/catalog pins/2026-03-22 PR#2250.

anita: Suggestion: set KV cache TTL to 60s for quanted responses to reduce cold-cache tail. Also add a transient-pref bias so traffic can revert to fp16 quickly if latency regresses.

mike: I'll add a dashboard tile and alerts. Metrics: model RPS, p50/p95, 5xx rate, cost/token, cache hit. Alert thresholds: p95 > 1.15s for 4m OR 5xx > 0.45% -> page on-call, start automated rollback timer.

james: For rollback automation, deploy-bot supports crowdcontrol hooks. Proposed triggers: p95 > 1.15s sustained 4m OR 5xx > 0.45% for 3m. Action: pin global to rdo-8b-fp16 and update catalog to disable rdo-4b-q2. Also block re-enable for 12h.

maria: Implemented rollback-policy/2026-03-rdo4b with those thresholds and 12h cooldown. Also added a safety gate: if cost drop is >25% but p95 increases >0.3s we still roll back.

sara: Release notes draft: "Enable rdo-4b-q2 (quantized) as a cost-optimized fallback for chat; canary rollout with automated rollback on latency/error thresholds; cache TTLs adjusted; embeddings/rerank excluded. Quant may show minor output variation vs fp16; pin routes if strict parity required."

anita: LGTM. Add a note to SRE runbook about how to snapshot pinlist diffs and collect a 5-minute request sample if rollback happens.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: catalog.enable rdo-4b-q2 canary (1%). Job URL: https://deploys/redwood/jobs/4988/log

mike: First 10m: p95=0.66s, errors=0.01%, cost/token down ~20%. No early red flags.

sara: Saw some cold-start bursts during a short traffic spike; TTL=60s is helping after a few minutes.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced: 5% at 2026-03-23T06:40:00Z

mike: At 5% for 25m: p95=0.71s, errors=0.02%. Cache hit rate improving. Okay to proceed toward 25% if stable another 30m.

james: Queued the 25% ramp step and created changelog CL-1800. Reminder: keep the pinlist snapshot handy for quick revert.

maria: Operational ask: if p95 creeps above 1.0s after 25% ramp, announce @channel immediately and prepare to flip safe-mode.

mike: I've added a short postmortem template in the rollout ticket: include trigger time, short metrics snapshot, pinlist diff link, and /internal/logs request dump.

deploy-bot: Advanced to 25% at 2026-03-23T07:35:00Z. Monitoring window: 30m.

mike: At 25% steady: p95=0.82s, errors=0.03% (under thresholds), cost savings steady ~18%. No rollback required.

sara: Fallback ordering behaves as expected: quant takes precedence on eligible routes. No embeddings traffic affected.

anita: I'll keep watch for any customer quality reports. If we see consistent quality complaints, we'll recommend route-level pins to fp16.

deploy-bot: Finalized rollout to 100% at 2026-03-23T08:50:00Z. Changelog: CL-1800. Pinlist final: infra/catalog pins/2026-03-23/CL-1800

maria: Nice work. I'll close the rollout ticket later today and publish release notes. If anyone sees sustained p95 > 1.0s after full rollout, ping @channel and we'll initiate incident flow.

participants: maria, deploy-bot, sara, anita, mike, james
